known_limitations: Clouds/shadows are not masked in this dataset (see docs/DATA_ACCESS_GUIDE.md); this run does not mask them either.
LST is not available upstream; this run uses 6 channels (B02,B03,B04,B08,NDVI,NDWI), not the full assigned 7.
Pixels were randomly subsampled due to Isomap's quadratic-or-worse scaling; metrics describe the subsample, not the full tile.

explained_variance_ratio was originally logged as 1.0 by a pre-fix version of src/evaluation.py; this was a measurement artifact (scikit-learn's Isomap truncates its internal eigenvalues to n_components before exposing them, so the ratio was trivially 1.0 by construction), corrected here to None - see documentation/02_isomap_stage4_5.md.
